channel.description: A weekly editorial digest connecting research, ideas and practical questions about AI and human attention.

item.title: The Attention Edit #01 — Who's doing the thinking?
item.description: Across this week's education studies, public essays, and adjacent attention research, a recurring question is who retains judgment when technology makes work easier. The material raises promising ideas but doesn't establish a single causal answer. One question to keep: If an AI tool makes the task faster, what evidence would show that it also made our thinking better?
